# Lua test toolchain for CI (busted + luacheck), one rock per line: <name> <version>-<revision>.
# Every rock is pinned, transitive dependencies included, in dependency order (a rock after what it needs).
# .github/scripts/lua-rocks.sh installs exactly these and fails if the tree holds anything else.
# To bump: change the version on one line. The CI cache key hashes this file, so the next run reinstalls once.
